name: pii-tokens
description: Masks CPF, CNPJ, email, phone and personal fields (table columns, JSON keys) in tool output before Claude sees them, with reversible tokens kept in an encrypted local vault.

allowed_email_domains.title: Allowed email domains
allowed_email_domains.description: Email domains left unmasked, such as your company's. Subdomains are included.

table_tools.title: Tools that return tables
table_tools.description: Tool name prefixes whose output is a psql-style table, masked by column name. Example: mcp__postgres__

dev_tool_names.title: Keep developer tool names
dev_tool_names.description: Leave name fields visible in package.json, lockfiles, kubectl, docker inspect, terraform, OpenAPI and GitHub repo JSON. Off by default: every name field is masked. When on, a one-word name inside a document shaped like one of those tools is not masked.

readable_fields.title: Readable fields
readable_fields.description: Fields that hold no person's name, as tool:path. Example: mcp__monday__:**.items[].name keeps Monday card titles. A CPF, CNPJ, email or phone inside the field is still masked. Empty by default.

masked_fields.title: Masked fields
masked_fields.description: Fields that hold personal data although their name does not say so, as tool:path. Example: mcp__monday__:**.column_values[id=text_abc123].text masks one Monday column. Wins over readable fields. Empty by default.
